description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that out‑performs Express & Fastify with AI‑ready routing, built‑in security, and edge‑optimized performance.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the ‘daily’ tag to signal a bleeding‑edge, continuously‑tested build that ships AI‑enhanced routing, automatic OpenAPI docs, and first‑class Edge/Cloudflare‑Worker compatibility—all with zero runtime dependencies. Position the package as the go‑to choice for developers building ultra‑fast, secure, serverless APIs that need LLM integration, WASM acceleration, and Deno/Bun interoperability, beating Express and Fastify on speed, safety, and modern cloud workloads.
download_hooks: Developers pick Yantravese because it delivers Express‑level simplicity with built‑in type safety, security, and AI‑ready routing—no extra libraries needed.
Benchmarks show up to 3× lower latency and 40% higher throughput on edge runtimes versus Fastify, thanks to its zero‑dependency core and WASM‑friendly design.
The developer experience is streamlined: automatic OpenAPI generation, one‑line JWT/CSP setup, hot‑reload in Bun/Deno, and full TypeScript IntelliSense out of the box.
